glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 角 (“horn”) + 刀 (“knife”) + 牛 (“cow”) – a knife separates a horn from a cow, i.e. “cut up (an ox)”.
senses: [jiě] to loosen; to unfasten; to untie
[jiě] to divide; to break up; to split; to separate
[jiè] to introduce a scholar to the imperial palace
[xiè] skills; moves (of martial arts, dance, acrobatics, etc.)
[xiè] (dated, music) to conclude a piece; to complete
